006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.ContextAbsentDynamicMetapathException;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.format.IPathFormatter;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDocumentNodeItem;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
019import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
020import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
021
022import java.util.List;
023
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
026
027/**
028 * Implements the XPath 3.1
029 * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-path">fn:path</a>
030 * functions.
031 * <p>
032 * This implementation differs from the XPath specification by returning a
033 * Metapath expression instead of an XPath expression.
034 */
035public final class FnPath {
036  private static final String NAME = "path";
037  @NonNull
038  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_NO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
039      .name(NAME)
040      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
041      .deterministic()
042      .contextDependent()
043      .focusDependent()
044      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
045      .returnZeroOrOne()
046      .functionHandler(FnPath::executeNoArg)
047      .build();
048
049  @NonNull
050  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
051      .name(NAME)
052      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
053      .deterministic()
054      .contextIndependent()
055      .focusIndependent()
056      .argument(IArgument.builder()
057          .name("arg1")
058          .type(INodeItem.type())
059          .zeroOrOne()
060          .build())
061      .returnType(IStringItem.type())
062      .returnZeroOrOne()
063      .functionHandler(FnPath::executeOneArg)
064      .build();
065
066  private FnPath() {
067    // disable construction
068  }
069
070  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
071  @NonNull
072  private static ISequence<IStringItem> executeNoArg(@NonNull IFunction function,
073      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
074      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
075      IItem focus) {
076
077    ISequence<IStringItem> retval;
078    if (focus == null) {
079      // Per XPath 3.1: If the context item is absent, dynamic error [err:XPDY0002]
080      throw new ContextAbsentDynamicMetapathException(
081          "The context item is absent for fn:path()");
082    } else if (focus instanceof INodeItem) {
083      retval = ISequence.of(fnPath((INodeItem) focus));
084    } else {
085      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
086          focus,
087          String.format("Expected type '%s', but the context item was type '%s'.",
088              INodeItem.class.getName(),
089              focus.getClass().getName()));
090    }
091    return retval;
092  }
093
094  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
095  @NonNull
096  private static ISequence<IStringItem> executeOneArg(@NonNull IFunction function,
097      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
098      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
099      IItem focus) {
100
101    return fnPath(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * An implementation of XPath 3.1
106   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-path">fn:path</a>.
107   *
108   * @param sequence
109   *          a Metapath sequence containing an item to get the Metapath for
110   * @return a sequence containing the generated Metapath
111   */
112  @NonNull
113  public static ISequence<IStringItem> fnPath(@NonNull ISequence<?> sequence) {
114    IItem item = sequence.getFirstItem(true);
115
116    ISequence<IStringItem> retval;
117    if (item == null) {
118      retval = ISequence.empty();
119    } else {
120      try {
121        retval = ISequence.of(fnPath((INodeItem) item));
122      } catch (ClassCastException ex) {
123        throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
124            item,
125            String.format("Expected a '%s', but received a '%s'",
126                INodeItem.class.getName(),
127                item.getClass().getName()),
128            ex);
129      }
130    }
131    return retval;
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Generates a Metapath for the provided item.
136   *
137   * @param item
138   *          the item to get the Metapath for
139   * @return the generated Metapath
140   */
141  @Nullable
142  public static IStringItem fnPath(@Nullable INodeItem item) {
143    if (item == null) {
144      return null;
145    }
146    String path = item.toPath(IPathFormatter.METAPATH_PATH_FORMATER);
147    // Per XPath 3.1, document nodes return "/" for their path
148    // The MetapathFormatter returns empty string for document nodes
149    // (to enable proper joining), so we need to handle this case
150    if (item instanceof IDocumentNodeItem && path.isEmpty()) {
151      path = "/";
152    }
153    return IStringItem.valueOf(path);
154  }
155}
